images.subject: An open picture book seen from slightly above, its pages fanning up like wings, with a small round star glowing lantern gold rising out of the pages and lighting them warmly. Simple and bold enough to read at the size of a fingertip.
images.background: Flat warm night blue with a faint dry-brush texture, a few tiny cream dots of stars far apart.
mustShow: the open book, big and centered
the glowing star, the warmest and brightest spot
avoid: characters from any story (the icon is the app, not one story)
rounded corners or a border: the stores round the corners themselves

images.subject: The same open book and glowing star as app-icon, alone on a transparent background, the same size and position.
mustShow: everything inside the central safe circle
avoid: any background color: it comes from app-icon-background

images.subject: The background of app-icon alone, edge to edge: flat warm night blue, faint dry-brush texture, a few tiny cream stars.
